sourceScope: Frozen v10; subsequent Vue-config same-content mtime compatibility revision is not included. Registered Native script/template/style scenarios do not exercise Vue-config extraction.
limits: All 96 driver windows retained; callback/read attribution covers only 32 native-page-script windows in the companion analysis.
Resource snapshots add synchronous observation overhead. ELU is main-thread active/idle time; CPU is cumulative process time across threads, not an additive wall phase.
GC occurrence uses entry.startTime/duration. Memory and CPU snapshots describe observer delivery, not the beginning or end of GC.
Output polls include reachable-script reads, cached import discovery or Babel parsing, predicates and observation; they are not single disk read timings.
Capture intervals also include sample creation, input hashing, output snapshots and comparison; they are not pure artifact I/O.
Exit drains delivered and queued PerformanceObserver entries only; no extra tick waits, signal handlers or timers are installed.
No stable performance or polling-only causal conclusion follows from these diagnostic windows.
